$comment: REQ-012 FR-4b (D-2907, D-2908): the source mapping behind product/qa/launch-review/<date>/claims-and-sources.md. One entry per public sentence (verbatim, whitespace folded); the table generator (scripts/ops/claims-table.mjs) joins them to the extractor's sentences. Statuses: VERIFIED (read against the instrument named, with the fetched date), VERIFIED-SECONDARY (a Commission web page or a third party, not the instrument), CHANGED (the copy's words differ from the instrument; D-2222 wording pending), UNVERIFIED (no source today). The eight D-2908 facts are entered first. Dates are ISO days; read-by is a role.

entries.sentence: The Commission does not charge an application fee.
entries.instrument: No instrument sets a fee; the ABLIS entry for NDIS provider registration lists none (secondary)
entries.note: D-2908 (1): ABLIS-sourced with the caveat kept in the guide's Sources section; the cost guide's status line records the pass of 18 Oct 2026.

entries.sentence: Certified providers pay for a second, smaller audit about 18 months in.
entries.instrument: NDIS (Provider Registration and Practice Standards) Rules 2018 s 13B: the mid-term audit no later than 18 months after registration
entries.note: D-2908 (2): the Rules say no later than 18 months; the copy says about 18 months. Wording for the PO (D-2222): "no later than 18 months in".

entries.sentence: If your audit is certification, the Commission requires a mid-term audit about 18 months after registration.
entries.note: D-2908 (2): "about" against the Rules' "no later than"; D-2222.

entries.sentence: Three years. A renewal audit happens before it expires. Certified providers also have the mid-term audit at about 18 months.
entries.instrument: NDIS Act 2013 s 73E (the period of registration, usually three years); Rules s 13B for the mid-term audit
entries.note: D-2908 (5) and (2): the PO names s 73E ("usually"); the Act is not among the fetched sources, so the row waits for a read with its date; the "about 18 months" half is the s 13B CHANGED item.

entries.sentence: The final report goes to the Commission within 14 days of a verification audit, or 28 days of a certification or mid-term audit.
entries.note: D-2908 (3): no source id today; the Regulatory Expectations for Approved Quality Auditors (aqa-expectations, V1 June 2026) is the first place to read.

entries.sentence: Within 14 days of a verification audit, and within 28 days of a certification or mid-term audit.
entries.note: D-2908 (3), the same fact in the audit guide's FAQ.

entries.sentence: The auditor sends the report to the Commission within 14 days of a verification audit, or within 28 days of a certification or mid-term audit.
entries.note: D-2908 (3), the same fact in the which-audit guide.

entries.sentence: Stage 2 is an onsite audit within 3 months of stage 1: the auditor visits your business and talks to your workers and to some participants.
entries.note: D-2908 (4): no source today for the three months.

entries.sentence: Finish the application within 60 days of starting it, or the portal deletes it (the Commission's apply page).
entries.instrument: The Commission's apply-for-registration page (a web page, not an instrument)
entries.note: D-2908 (8): read 16 Oct 2026; a Commission apply page re-reads every 30 days (D-2910).

entries.sentence: No public sentence carries the worker screening clearance's five years or the 90-day renewal window.
entries.where: (no public sentence; the registers' status rules use 90 days: src/lib/registers/status.ts:138)
entries.instrument: NDIS (Worker Screening) Rules 2018; the Worker Screening Act of each state (the clearance's term)
entries.note: D-2908 (6): the fact lives in the registers' rules and the generated documents' fixed text, not on a public page; listed so it is not lost.

entries.sentence: No public sentence carries the reportable incident's 24 hours or 5 business days.
entries.where: (no public sentence; the generated documents' fixed text, batch 45 Session B, carries ss 20 and 21)
entries.instrument: NDIS (Incident Management and Reportable Incidents) Rules 2018 ss 20 and 21
entries.note: D-2908 (7): read against the Rules on 15 Oct 2026 for the fixed text; no public page states it.
